notes.notes: [p]The big one: More normal camera controls[/p][list][*][p]The camera now handles mouse input differently and is a lot less reliant on your dpi.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Small changes:[/p][list][*][p]Cyberspace loads your camera speed instead of using the default one[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in cyberspace that lead to a logic loop of the final boss[/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to the gate and the elevator in the station entrance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the baby pickup to spawn twice in the sewers[/p][/*][*][p]Made the robot at the top of the generator a bit more responsive (just a bit)[/p][/*][*][p]Made the office elevator more legible[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked some sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added a little friend somewhere that I've been thinking about[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please note: For now, this update unfortunately only affects the PC version as I can not produce a Mac build from my computer.[/p]

notes.title: Camera Update
notes.notes:
I made some adjustments based on your feedback:

[list]
[*] You can now select between [b]two camera modes[/b] in the options: "Follow loosely" and "Locked to player", which is a more traditional camera and enabled by default.
[*] The [b]camera sensitivity[/b] option has been adjusted to take high screen resolutions into account.
[*] The [b]speed of the item wheel[/b] is now directly tied to the camera speed.
[*] [b]Jumping [/b]has been slightly tweaked and debugged. 
[*] I found some [b]boring bugs[/b] along the way that are now fixed as well.
[/list]
It's been great to see people play the demo, thank y'all so much! Let me know how these changes work out for you.
